1.explanation:
1. We import the ActionableNotification directly from @carbon/react and include Carbon’s CSS so the notification styling is applied.  
2. We pass in title, subtitle, caption, actionButtonLabel, onActionButtonClick, onClose, statusIconDescription, and hideCloseButton props exactly as shown in the documentation.  
3. Even though caption is defined in the component’s propTypes and appears in the docs, it isn’t bound in the component JSX, so you will see the title and subtitle but no caption text.  
4. This minimal example reproduces the missing caption behavior out of the box.
1.bug_scenario: The ActionableNotification component in @carbon/react declares a "caption" propType and your documentation shows a caption field (e.g. for timestamps), but the actual component never injects that caption string into its rendered output. When you pass a caption prop (for example, caption="Caption not working."), nothing appears in the notification UI.
